dialogues.speaker: Cheriez
dialogues.text: I just bumped into an old friend, who said he saw a place with loads of Condessence Crystals on the way here. There was even some Magical Crystal Ore!

dialogues.speaker: Cheriez
dialogues.text: Now, I was in the ore business for a while myself, but not any longer. If you need some, I'd say... this place is a good shout.
